roles: SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolconnlimit FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' ORDER BY rolname
schemas: SELECT n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl,acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a) AS acl FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') ORDER BY n.nspname
tables: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relpersistence,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.relreplident,c.relispartition,c.reloptions,am.amname,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a) AS acl FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.relam WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname
columns: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,a.attstorage,a.attcompression,CASE WHEN a.attcollation<>0 THEN a.attcollation::regcollation::text END AS collation,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expr,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(a.attacl) a) AS acl FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum
enums: SELECT n.nspname,t.typname,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) AS owner,(SELECT jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid=t.oid) AS labels,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(t.typacl,acldefault('T',t.typowner))) a) AS acl FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') AND t.typtype='e' ORDER BY 1,2
constraints: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,con.conname,con.contype,con.condeferrable,con.condeferred,con.convalidated,pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,false) AS definition FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,con.conname
indexes: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,ic.relname AS name,pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS definition,i.indisvalid,i.indisready,i.indisreplident,con.conname AS constraint_name FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indrelid JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_constraint con ON con.conindid=i.indexrelid AND con.contype IN ('p','u','x') WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,ic.relname
policies: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,p.polname,p.polcmd,p.polpermissive,(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE role_id WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(role_id) END ORDER BY role_id) FROM unnest(p.polroles) role_id) AS roles,pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) AS using_expr,pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) AS check_expr FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,p.polname
triggers: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,false) AS definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname
sequences: SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,format_type(s.seqtypid,null) AS type,s.seqstart,s.seqincrement,s.seqmax,s.seqmin,s.seqcache,s.seqcycle,d.deptype,rn.nspname AS owned_schema,rc.relname AS owned_table,a.attname AS owned_column,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl,acldefault('S',c.relowner))) a) AS acl FROM pg_sequence s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=s.seqrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.objid=c.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.deptype IN ('a','i') LEFT JOIN pg_class rc ON rc.oid=d.refobjid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid=rc.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=d.refobjid AND a.attnum=d.refobjsubid WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname
default_acl: SELECT pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS owner,n.nspname,d.defaclobjtype,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a) AS acl FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace WHERE d.defaclnamespace=0 OR n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') ORDER BY 1,2,3
memberships: SELECT pg_get_userbyid(roleid) AS role,pg_get_userbyid(member) AS member,pg_get_userbyid(grantor) AS grantor,admin_option,inherit_option,set_option FROM pg_auth_members ORDER BY 1,2
functions: SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_args,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,l.lanname AS language,p.prosecdef,p.provolatile,p.proleakproof,p.proisstrict,p.proparallel,p.proconfig,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantee',CASE a.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY a.grantee,a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a) AS acl FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','moderation_private','auth','storage','private','account_requests_private','care_private','validation_private','community_private','place_private','document_private','rescue_private') AND p.prokind='f' ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid
